title: With the n-way join, -flambda2-debug-concrete-types-only-on-canonicals stops the compiler
summary: With `-flambda2-join-algorithm n-way` and `-flambda2-debug-concrete-types-only-on-canonicals` at `-O2` or `-O3`, Simplify stops on a function that matches a variant twice around a loop: "Trying to add equation giving concrete type on ... which is not canonical". Whether it stops depends on the name of the unit (`prog.ml` stops).

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Trying to add equation giving concrete type on ... which is not canonical`, exit status 2.

cause: `middle_end/flambda2/types/env/meet_env.ml`, `add_concrete_equation_on_canonical_name`, is called while the n-way join adds its equations (`join_env.ml`) on a name that is no longer canonical.
